entries.content: Done. Root cause: `PandasDataframe.broadcast_apply_full_axis` only computed `row_lengths`/`column_widths` caches when `keep_partitioning=False`, even though with `keep_partitioning=True` the split boundaries along the applied axis are preserved by `broadcast_axis_partitions` (as long as the number of splits and total length are unchanged, per the length checks in `deploy_axis_func`). Fix: added an `else` branch that, when partitioning is kept, copies the existing `_row_lengths_cache` (axis=0) or `_column_widths_cache` (axis=1) to the result — but only when `num_splits` preserves the split count along that axis and a materialized `new_index`/`new_columns` of matching total length is provided, guaranteeing the cache stays consistent. Verified caches are propagated when valid, not propagated when the function changes lengths, and existing binary/map-metadata test suites pass.
